questions.question: Differentiate digital marketing from tradition marketing. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html: • Differentiate digital marketing from traditional marketing. [U] / [CO1] Digital Marketing :Uses websites, search engines, email and social media. Allows quick interaction through messages and comments. Targets specific audiences. Campaigns can be changed quickly at lower cost. Traditional Marketing :Uses newspapers, TV, radio and posters. Reaches a broad audience. Measures results using surveys and audience estimates. Changes may take more time and money. Example: Instagram advertising is digital marketing, whereas newspaper advertising is traditional marketing.(Mark Distribution: Any five valid differences – 1 mark each (5 marks).)

questions.question: Explain the critical role of web analytics in digital marketing. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html: • Explain the critical role of web analytics in digital marketing. [U] / [CO2] Answer: Web analytics is the process of collecting, measuring, analyzing and reporting website data to understand user behavior and improve digital marketing performance. Role of Web Analytics :Website Traffic Analysis, Understanding User Behavior, Conversion Tracking,Campaign Performance Measurement,Decision Making and Optimization: Example: Google Analytics can help an online store identify which marketing channels generate the most purchases.

questions.question: Write the advantages and limitations of influencer marketing for businesses. / [CO2] [5x4 = 20]
questions.solution_html: • Write the advantage and limitations of influencer marketing for business.[An] / [CO2] Answer: Influencer marketing is a digital marketing strategy in which businesses collaborate with social media influencers to promote products or services to their followers. Advantages: Increases Brand Awareness,Builds Credibility: Reaches Target Audiences: Limitations: High Cost: Risk of Fake Followers and Engagement, Artificial engagement can reduce campaign effectiveness.Reputation Risk: Controversial influencer behavior or misleading promotions may negatively affect the brand. Example: A cosmetics company collaborating with a beauty influencer on Instagram to promote a new skincare product.
